Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 if :cryo_worksheet_id is not null
 then
 begin
 
 select distinct 'x' into :GLOBAL.x
 from cryo_units x
 where cryo_worksheet_id = :cryo_worksheet_id and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 ( (0 = (select count(*)
 from cryo_units c
 where c.cryo_worksheet_id =
 x.cryo_worksheet_id and
 c.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 thaw_method is not null
 )
 ) OR 
 
 exists (select 'X' from cryo_units Y where y.cryo_worksheet_id=x.cryo_worksheet_id and
 Y.unit_id not in (Select unit_id from cryo_units Z where Z.cryo_worksheet_id = X.cryo_worksheet_id and 
 chapter_id=:global.chapter_id and Z.thaw_method is not null
 )
 
 ) 
 ); 
 
 
 /*
 select distinct 'x' into :GLOBAL.x from cryo_units X where cryo_worksheet_id = :ctrl_blk_1.cryo_worksheet_id and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id 
 and ( 0 = ((select count(*) from cryo_units c where c.cryo_worksheet_id = X.cryo_worksheet_id and chapter_id= :global.chapter_id 
 and thaw_method is not null)) 
 OR
 ((select count(*) from cryo_units Y where y.cryo_worksheet_id=x.cryo_worksheet_id) <> (select count(*) from cryo_units Z where Z.cryo_worksheet_id = X.cryo_worksheet_id 
 and chapter_id=:global.chapter_id and Z.thaw_method is not null)));
 */
 
 
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error('1149');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 
 begin
 select count(*) into :GLOBAL.last_unit_number
 from cryo_units
 where cryo_worksheet_id = :cryo_worksheet_id and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then

 check_package_failure;
 end;
 else
 :GLOBAL.last_unit_number := 0;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_bag_code VARCHAR2(1);
 temp_red_tube_flag VARCHAR2(10);
 temp_bleed_start_time date;
 temp_bleed_end_time date;
 temp_count number;
 temp_cryo_worksheet_id VARCHAR2(14);
 temp_unit VARCHAR2(15);
 temp_abo_result VARCHAR2(2);
 nUnits NUMBER:=0;
 temp_abo_label VARCHAR2(2);
 nBIO NUMBER:=0;
 temp_identifier_code VARCHAR2(2);
 
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 :GLOBAL.unit_form_checkin_flag := 'Y';
 default_value('N','GLOBAL.checked_bleed_time');
 default_value('111111111111111','GLOBAL.max_bleed_time');
 default_value('111111111111111','GLOBAL.slow_bleed_time');
 --message('Pass....0');pause;


 if :GLOBAL.checked_bleed_time = 'N'
 then
 -- this is to avoid database access repeatedly for
 -- same reason
 begin
 select max_bleed_time, slow_bleed_time
 into :GLOBAL.max_bleed_time, :GLOBAL.slow_bleed_time
 from chapters
 where chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 sysdate between eff_date and
 nvl(term_date,sysdate+365);
 :GLOBAL.checked_bleed_time := 'Y';
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message
 ('Error is checking bleed times from chapters');
 handle_error;
 check_package_Failure;
 end;
 end if;
 --message('Pass....1');pause;

 begin
 select max(coll_date), donor_decision_code
 into :ctrl_blk_2.coll_date, :GLOBAL.donor_decision_code
 from units
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 ''||contract_id = 'INTERNAL' and
 not exists (select 'x'
 from unit_attributes
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.CHAPTER_ID and
 trunc(coll_date) =
 trunc(units.coll_date) and
 attrib_group = 'PHER')
 group by donor_decision_code;
 if :ctrl_blk_2.coll_date is null
 then
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0063');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0063');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in selecting CUE from units');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 
 --message('Pass....2');pause;
 
 begin
 select nvl(count(*),0) into nUnits 
 from cryo_units
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 If nUnits > 0 then 
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0171');
 check_package_Failure;
 Else
 null;
 End If;
 end;
 -- message('Pass....3');pause;
 -- message('Donor decision code='||:GLOBAL.donor_decision_code);pause;
 
 
 if :GLOBAL.donor_decision_code != 'S'
 then
 begin
 select distinct 'x' into :GLOBAL.x
 from unit_interdictions, valid_interdictions_lab
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 unit_interdictions.inter_code =
 valid_interdictions_lab.inter_code and
 inter_type != 'I';
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0184');
 check_package_failure;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 null;
 when OTHERS
 then
 --message('Error in selecting from unit_inter');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;

 BEGIN
 SELECT distinct 'x' into :GLOBAL.x
 FROM component_interdictions ci, valid_products vp, valid_interdictions_lab vi
 WHERE ci.unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id and
 trunc(ci.coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 ci.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 substr(ci.product_code,1,5) = vp.product_code and
 vp.product_type = 'DUFFP' and
 sysdate between vp.eff_date and nvl(vp.term_date,sysdate) and
 ci.inter_code = vi.inter_code and
 vi.inter_type != 'I' and
 sysdate between vi.eff_date and nvl(vi.term_date,sysdate) ;
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0184');
 check_package_failure;
 exception 
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 null;
 when OTHERS
 then
 --message('Error in selecting from comp_inter');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END ;
 
 
 begin
 select distinct result_status_1
 into temp_abo_result
 from utrs
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 test_id = 'ABORH' and
 cancel_flag is null and
 result_status_1 is not null;
 if temp_abo_result not in ('06','17','28','51',
 '62','73','84','95')
 then
 :GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id := :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_coll_date := :ctrl_blk_2.coll_date;
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0178');
 check_package_Failure;
 else
 begin
 select code_desc
 into :s_abo_desc
 from master_codes
 where code = temp_abo_result
 and code_type = 'ABO' and
 sysdate between eff_date and
 nvl(term_date,sysdate+365);
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in displaying abo desc');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND or TOO_MANY_ROWS
 then
 :GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id := :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_coll_date:=:ctrl_blk_2.coll_date;
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0178');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in selecting from utrs');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 
 
 begin
 select distinct 'x' into :GLOBAL.x
 from unit_test_base, valid_tests
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 unit_test_base.test_id = valid_tests.test_id and
 cancel_flag is null and
 (antigen_flag != 'Y' or
 valid_tests.test_id in ('ALT','ABORH'));
 show_error('0051');
 check_package_failure;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 null;
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in selecting from utb');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 declare
 cursor c1 is 
 select ct.test_id 
 from contract_tests ct, units u 
 where u.unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id 
 and u.chapter_id = :Global.chapter_id
 and u.chapter_id = ct.chapter_id
 and trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date)
 and u.contract_id = ct.contract_id
 and ct.stop_label_flag = 'Y'
 and sysdate between ct.eff_date and nvl(ct.term_date, sysdate);
 begin
 for te in c1
 loop
 begin
 select distinct 'x' into :GLOBAL.x
 from utrs, valid_tests
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id
 and trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date)
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id 
 and utrs.test_id = valid_tests.test_id 
 and antigen_flag != 'Y' 
 and valid_tests.test_id = te.test_id
 and result_status_1 is null 
 and cancel_flag is null;
 show_error('0052');
 exception
 when form_trigger_failure then
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 when no_data_found then
 null;
 when too_many_rows then
 show_error('0052');
 when others then
 null; 
 end;
 end loop;
 end;
 ELSE --- for autologus unit
 
 begin
 select distinct result_status_1
 into temp_abo_result
 from utrs
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 test_id = 'ABORH' and
 cancel_flag is null and
 result_status_1 is not null;
 
 If temp_abo_result not in ('06','17','28','51',
 '62','73','84','95')
 then
 :GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id := :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_coll_date := :ctrl_blk_2.coll_date;
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0178');
 check_package_Failure;
 Else
 -- Check for bio to decide AUTO BIO
 
 temp_abo_label:=null;
 
 select nvl(count(*),0) into nBIO from valid_interdictions_lab where inter_type='B' and
 inter_code in (select inter_code from unit_interdictions where unit_id=:ctrl_blk_2.unit_id);
 
 If nBIO > 0 then 
 temp_identifier_code:='AB';
 Else
 temp_identifier_code:='AO';
 End If;
 
 begin
 select abo_label into temp_abo_label from valid_abo_values where
 tested_abo_code=temp_abo_result and identifier_code=temp_identifier_code and 
 upper(abo_short_name) not like '%GRP%' and rownum=1;
 exception when others then 
 temp_abo_label:=temp_abo_result;
 end;
 
 
 begin
 select code_desc
 into :s_abo_desc
 from master_codes
 where code = nvl(temp_abo_label,temp_abo_result)
 and code_type = 'ABO' and
 sysdate between eff_date and
 nvl(term_date,sysdate+365);
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in displaying abo desc');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 End if;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND or TOO_MANY_ROWS
 then
 :GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id := :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_coll_date:=:ctrl_blk_2.coll_date;
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0178');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in selecting from utrs');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 
 
 END IF;
 --message('Pass...5');pause;
 
 begin
 -- to check if the bag code
 select bleed_start_time, bleed_end_time
 into temp_bleed_start_time, temp_bleed_end_time
 from units
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:ctrl_blk_2.coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 if temp_bleed_start_time is null or
 temp_bleed_end_time is null
 then
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0065');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 if (temp_bleed_end_time-temp_bleed_start_time)*24*60
 between to_number(:GLOBAL.slow_bleed_time) and
 to_number(:GLOBAL.max_bleed_time)
 then
 :GLOBAL.slow_bleed := 'Y';
 else
 :GLOBAL.slow_bleed := 'N';
 end if;
 end if;
 
 -- message('Pass...6');pause;
 reconcile_bags(:ctrl_blk_2.unit_id,:ctrl_blk_2.coll_date,
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id,temp_count,
 temp_bag_code);
 check_package_failure;
 --message('Pass...7');pause;

 if temp_bag_code is null
 then
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0039');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in selecting bleed times from units');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 if temp_count < 1
 then
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id := :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_coll_date := :ctrl_blk_2.coll_date;
 show_error('0135');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
exception
 when form_trigger_failure then
 handle_error;
 raise form_trigger_failure;
end;

Item.Name: PROD_CODE
Item.Hint: Enter the component to be converted or use [LISTVAL]

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_count number;
 l_count number := 0;
 temp_intr number;
 temp_freez number:=0;
begin
 IF :GLOBAL.tz_enabled = 'Y' THEN
 :ctrl_blk_2.s_sysdate := Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_lcl_time(:GLOBAL.tz_enabled, :GLOBAL.tz_offset, SYSDATE);
 ELSE
 :ctrl_blk_2.s_sysdate := SYSDATE;
 END IF; 


 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;

--message(:ctrl_blk_1.unit_id||','|| :GLOBAL.warehouse);pause;
 
 /* 3.1 - added check that product exists in current warehouse - diptiiabbraham 09-25-05*/
 select count(1) into l_count
 from components
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id
 and warehouse_id = :GLOBAL.warehouse; 

 if l_count = 0 then
 show_error('0228');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 
 
 
 Begin

 /*3.1 Check if INTR interdiction is placed on the unit - Diptiiabbraham*/
 
 begin
 select count(1) into temp_intr
 from components cp, component_interdictions ci
 where cp.unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id 
 and cp.unit_id = ci.unit_id
 and cp.coll_date = ci.coll_date
 and cp.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and ci.inter_code = 'INTR'
 and ci.product_code = :prod_code; 
 
 if temp_intr > 0 then
 show_error('0031');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 
 
 --
 -- A component already pooled or relabeled cannot
 -- be converted simply because it does not exist
 -- anymore
 --
 select distinct a.product_code, product_desc,
 bag_id
 into :prod_code, :s_old_desc,
 :GLOBAL.old_bag_id
 from components a, valid_products b
 where a.unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id and
 a.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id and
 trunc(a.coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 a.product_code = :prod_code and
 a.component_status = 'L' and
 a.reject_reason_code is null and
 b.product_type in('DUFFP') and
 SUBSTR(a.product_code,1,5) = b.product_code and --HCLC
 b.unit_scheme_type = 'I' and --HCLC
 :ctrl_blk_2.s_sysdate between eff_date and
 nvl(term_date,:ctrl_blk_2.s_sysdate+365);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 :s_old_desc := '';
 show_error('1205');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 End;
 
 --- CHeck if the start freez time is entered -- MLT 5603
 
 begin
 Select nvl(count(*),0) into temp_freez from component_cgmp where
 unit_id= :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id and product_code=:ctrl_blk_2.prod_code and process_dats is not null;
 
 If temp_freez = 0 then 
 show_error('9195');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 
 exception when others then 
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 
 

---message('2222');pause;

 CHECK_INTRANSIT_INTERDICTION (:ctrl_blk_2.unit_id,
 :ctrl_blk_2.coll_date,
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 :ctrl_blk_2.prod_code,
 null, 
 :GLOBAL.warehouse,
 'INTR');
 begin
 -- Split components cannot be converted
 select count(*) into temp_count
 from components
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id and
 chapter_id = :global.chapter_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 SUBSTR(product_code,1,5) = SUBSTR(:prod_code,1,5);
 if temp_count > 1
 then
 --:GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id := :unit_id;
 --:GLOBAL.user_err_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 --:GLOBAL.user_err_coll_date := :coll_date;
 --:GLOBAL.user_err_product_code := :new_product_code;
 show_error('0157');
 check_package_Failure;
 end if;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 
 --- message('2222000');pause;
 --- Get the product type for teh SCR 152021
 
 begin
 SELECT product_type

ProgramUnit.Name: GENERATE_CRYO_WORKSHEET_ID
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure generate_cryo_worksheet_id is
 v_local_time date;
begin
 begin
 select nvl(ws_seq,1000)+1
 into :GLOBAL.cryo_worksheet_id
 from chapters
 where chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+365)
 for update of ws_seq;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error('0090');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 update chapters
 set ws_seq = :GLOBAL.cryo_worksheet_id,
 program_id = :banner.prog_name
 where chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+365);
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 
 else
 v_local_time := sysdate;
 end if;
 :cryo_worksheet_id := to_char(v_local_time,'MMDDYY')||
 '-CY'||:GLOBAL.cryo_worksheet_id;
 end;
 
 
end;
